topic: Compilation of outrageous football chants/insults aimed at players, shown as phone-shot vertical clips with captions
hero: Players targeted by chants (James Madison, Erling Haaland, Bruno Fernandes, Zlatan, Mesut Ozil, Luis Suarez, Jonjo Shelvey, Wayne Rooney)
hook: Vertical phone clip, James Madison on pitch with caption quote and name
subtitle_style: white italic quote text over clip, then name in white bold caps with black outline below, centred, channel watermark 'Nost FC'
reaction_overlays: blurred side-fill of same clip (vertical in 16:9), Nost FC watermark; no emoji
transition_summary: Hard cuts every ~8 s per chant, each segment slow with one clip; ~1 cut per 8-9 s
audio_note: original stadium crowd chants audible (inferred from titles/captions), no music inferable

reuse_segments.what: Phone-shot fan clips of chants at Premier League matches
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: clip chants from owned/licensed fan footage or recreate with audio only; strip watermark
